title: Associativity of K-flat total tensor complexes across a ring tower
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ and $B$ be commutative $R$-algebras, and let $E$ and $K$ be complexes of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Choose K-flat resolutions $P_E \to E$ and $P_K \to K$ over $A$ and $Q \to B$ over $R$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. The canonical rebracketing map of total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] $$\operatorname{Tot}((P_E \otimes_A P_K) \otimes_R Q) \longrightarrow \operatorname{Tot}(P_E \otimes_A (P_K \otimes_R Q))$$ is a natural chain isomorphism. After passage to $D(A)$ it commutes with the endomorphisms of both sides induced by any endomorphism of $B$ in $D(R)$ (transported along $Q \to B$; in particular with the action of each $b \in B$ by multiplication on $B$), and after passage to the derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] it is independent of the chosen resolutions and natural in $E$, $K$, and morphisms.

proof.text: Choose the K-flat resolutions P_E → E and P_K → K over A and Q → B over R supplied by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. By the definitions of K-flat derived tensor and total tensor complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the two displayed derived tensor expressions are represented by Tot((P_E tensor_A P_K) tensor_R Q) and Tot(P_E tensor_A (P_K tensor_R Q)), with the A-action through P_E.

Apply the Mathlib associator [lem-pc-kflat-total-tensor-associativity] to the tensor bifunctors over A and R and their canonical associativity comparison. It supplies the natural chain isomorphism between these two total complexes, hence an isomorphism in D(A).

source.place: Tag 0BYJ, associativity of total tensor products

proof.text: Write $X=\operatorname{Tot}(P_E\otimes_A P_K)$, a complex of $A$-modules. The endomorphisms of the two sides induced by $\varphi\in\operatorname{End}_{D(R)}(B)$ are, by definition, the values on $\varphi$ of the functors $D(R)\to D(A)$ given by $-\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}X$ and by $P_E\otimes_A(-\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}P_K)$ [lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor, (2)], evaluated through the K-flat model $Q$ of $B$; the second is a functor because $P_E\otimes_A-$ preserves quasi-isomorphisms ($P_E$ is K-flat over $A$ [def-pc-kflat-complex]). The swap $q\otimes x\mapsto(-1)^{|q||x|}x\otimes q$ identifies $\operatorname{Tot}(Q\otimes_R X)$ with $\operatorname{Tot}(X\otimes_R Q)$ naturally in both variables (elementary sign check with the convention of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]), and likewise for $P_K$. A chain endomorphism of $Q$ representing $\varphi$ need not exist ($Q$ is only K-flat), so argue with roofs: $\varphi$ (transported to $Q$ along the quasi-isomorphism $Q\to B$) is represented by $Q\xleftarrow{s}Q''\xrightarrow{g}Q$ with $s$ a quasi-isomorphism, and replacing $Q''$ by a K-flat resolution of it [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] we may take $Q''$ K-flat. By [lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor, (1) and (2)] both functors send $s$ to a quasi-isomorphism and send $\varphi$ to the roof formed by the images of $s$ and $g$ under the respective chain-level constructions. The chain associator is natural in $Q$ [lem-pc-kflat-total-tensor-associativity], so it commutes with the images of $s$ and of $g$, hence with the image of $\varphi$ in $D(A)$. For $\varphi$ multiplication by $b\in B$ this is the stated action of $b$.

source.place: Tag 0BYJ, equivariance under endomorphisms of B

proof.text: The comparison isomorphisms between the models for different K-flat resolutions $P_E,P_K$ over $A$ and $Q$ over $R$, and the identifications of the models with the derived tensor objects, are the canonical ones of [lem-pc-balanced-derived-tensor-model] and [lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor, (2)]; each is represented by a roof of chain maps between K-flat resolutions (a common K-flat resolution of the fibre data maps to both by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]), whose legs are quasi-isomorphisms preserved by $P_E\otimes_A-$, $-\otimes_A P_K$ and $-\otimes_R Q$ on K-flat complexes. The chain associator is natural in all three variables [lem-pc-kflat-total-tensor-associativity], so it commutes with each leg of these roofs; hence its class in $D(A)$ is independent of $P_E$, $P_K$ and $Q$. A morphism $E\to E'$ or $K\to K'$ is likewise represented by a roof of chain maps between K-flat resolutions, and the same naturality gives naturality in $E$, $K$. These identifications are chain-level constructions in the $Q$-variable compatible with the roofs of Step 3, so the commutation with the transported $B$-endomorphisms is preserved, and so is its effect on cohomology.
